title: The Blacksmith
commons_title: File:Blacksmith - Celtic Aire - United States Air Force Band.mp3
composition: traditional English folk song; public domain
credit: Performance by Celtic Aire, United States Air Force Band (a work of the US Government, public domain).
lyrics: A blacksmith courted me nine months and better
He fairly won my heart, wrote me a letter
With his hammer in his hand he looked so clever
And if I were with my love I would live for ever
